{{Quote|That agriworld supplies nearly half of Coruscant's food&hellip; Any damage to Uphrades' food production could cripple the Republic.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]]|<ref name="Uphrades" />}}
The '''Uphrades system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] that contained the fertile [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Uphrades]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the system's 16 million inhabitants worked to supply the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with most of its [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] supplies, but an [[Devastation of Uphrades|attack]] on Uphrades by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] using the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] ravaged the planet's surface and left only a few hundred survivors. Those survivors were eventually rescued thanks to the efforts of the [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] ''[[Daybreaker]]'', whose crew had purposely crashed their [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] into Uphrades' now heavily [[Ion cannon/Legends|ionized]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] to reach them and bring aid, but Uphrades and its system remained barren and lifeless in the aftermath of Angral's assault.

==Description==
The Uphrades system was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="Uphrades" /> that was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], in the slice of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] region that lay between the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Named after its principal [[Planet/Legends|world]], the planet [[Uphrades]], the system was a major agricultural supplier for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] until the [[Devastation of Uphrades|devastation]] of Uphrades at the hands of [[Darth Angral]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]],<ref name="Uphrades" /> in [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|We've just picked up the tracking beacon's signal in the Uphrades system.|General Suthra|<ref name="Uphrades" />}}
The region in which the Uphrades system was located was largely explored by [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire, the system had become a major supplier of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] for Coruscant<ref name="Uphrades" /> thanks to the efforts of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] organization known as the [[Jedi Restoration Concord]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> However, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Angral targeted the planet<ref name="Uphrades" /> in 3643 BBY<ref name="Time" /> during his [[Desolator crisis|war against]] the Republic after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his son, [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], at the hands of a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]]. Angral utilized the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] on Uphrades, destroying most of the planet's surface and creating a small [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] around the planet. The attack completely destroyed Uphrades' ability to produce foodstuffs and killed almost all of the people on the surface, leaving only a few hundred survivors. The only [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to witness the attack, a Republic [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] named the ''[[Daybreaker]]'', was [[Attack on the Daybreaker|attacked]] by Angral's forces as he departed the system, but the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who was the target of the Sith's wrath defeated the Imperial boarding parties after coming to the damaged ship's aid near Uphrades.<ref name="Uphrades" />

[[File:Uphrades.png|thumb|left|170px|Uphrades after Angral's attack]]
{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
The ''Daybreaker''{{'s}} crew later sacrificed their ship to aid the survivors on Uphrades, despite the efforts of the ship's [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Dal (Cathar)|Dal]], to change his crew's mind, and the crew purposely crashed the ship by entering Uphrades' heavily [[Ion cannon/Legends|ionized]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] so that they could reach the survivors and ensure that they endured<ref name="Uphrades" /> until the Republic could rescue them.<ref name="Message">{{TORcite|type=message|News from Uphrades|Doctor Senessa}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

During the [[New Sith Wars]], a conflict that occurred over two thousand years later between the Republic and the Sith, the Uphrades system and the rest of the region was largely unaligned or contested, though that section of the Inner Rim was located within Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and was absorbed by the Republic's successor state, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], at the end of the conflict. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had taken control of that area by [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], when [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] led a [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] that temporarily reclaimed much of the northern [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] for the Empire, but by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[137 ABY]] the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]] under the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]] had taken control of the region in which the Uphrades system was located.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Orbital bodies==
===Uphrades===
{{Main|Uphrades}}
Uphrades, also known as "Coruscant's Granary" in the years before its devastation, was a thriving [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] with 16 million inhabitants during the Cold War. Its especially rich soil was the result of intense [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] activity around [[23,643 BBY]], and the planet possessed a breathable atmosphere, temperate climate, and five continents separated by significant surface [[Water/Legends|water]]. After Darth Angral's attack, Uphrades' greenery was turned to ash, and large chunks of the surface were ripped away, forming an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belt and exposing pockets of [[Magma/Legends|magma]] that vaporized the planet's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]].<ref name="Uphrades" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Uphrades_system.png|thumb|right|250px|The Uphrades system on the Galaxy Map, north of Coruscant, [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and a misplaced [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]]]
Uphrades and the Uphrades system first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], in which they are the location of the Jedi Knight class mission "Uphrades."<ref name="Uphrades" /> One of the regular updates to the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] of the [[2009]] reference guide ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Uphrades system in the Inner Rim with grid coordinates M-8.<ref name="EAOC" /> Players in ''The Old Republic'' can choose to ignore the life signs of the survivors on Uphrades for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] alignment points,<ref name="Uphrades" /> but as the Knight is a Republic character and is therefore assumed to make the moral [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] decisions,<ref name="Light Side">This article assumes that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] classes in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' choose the options that provide the most [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] alignment points.</ref> this article assumes that the ''Daybreaker'' sacrificed itself to reach the survivors and that they were eventually rescued.<ref name="Message" />
